description: The same rule as `a-normalized-stack-is-a-percentage`, from the other side. `guideFormat`'s test is `fieldOrDatumDef.stack === 'normalize' && config.normalizedNumberFormat`, and the second half of it is a **truthiness** test rather than a presence one — so a theme that sets `normalizedNumberFormat` to the empty string is asking for no percentage rather than for an empty one, and the axis falls through to whatever it would otherwise have shown. Upstream writes no `format` on it at all. Read as "is it set", the empty string is set, and the axis would be handed a specifier that formats every label as nothing.
